description.text: BIT MBA education started from 1994. The MBA Education Center belongs to School of Management and Economics, Beijing Institute of Technology, the Center specifically undertakes MBA project management of BIT under the guidance of the Graduate School. There are different departments within the MBA Education Center, which gives first-class student services to all students. The center consists of the department of marketing and admission, academic affairs, international exchange, career development, students affairs and alumni liaison. The MBA Education Center of Beijing Institute of Technology aims to lead an MBA program combined with outstanding education and business efficiency, as well as cultivate future leaders with dedicated and innovative capabilities. The MBA Education Center team has fully integrated resources from around the world. The program offers advanced management and leadership concepts and practices to enhance the quality of education as well as enhance the image of MBA. Time Arrangement TheFull-timeMBAprogramme isconductedfortwoyearsandclasstimemainlyfocusondaytime.

duration.text: The Full-time MBA at Beijing Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6888 USD/per year ￥ 49600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school Certificate of HSK (Not need for English taught programs) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 5.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Permission from the previous university for tranfer students (Not need for English taught programs) A student who has studied in China and wants to transfer to another university must provide the permission from original university. 7.Guardian’s Guarantee (Not need for English taught programs) For applicant under 18 years of age.
